Quick thoughts inline: subject lines (A/B/C) — keep short, signal value and time: 1) "How top teams serve LLMs at 99% SLA" 2) "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" 3) "Live: Serving LLMs — benchmarks, tradeoffs, Q&A". My vote: #3 for PLG list, #2 for marketplace leads (cost-focused).
